layer_metadata.description: Location of planning applications in Nottingham City with information about application dates, proposals, and decisions. This data contains all planning applications.

first_missing_criterion: machine-readable official planning-application feature records with application reference, proposal, status and geometry; official layer 13 query window (OBJECTID ASC, offset 0, cap 50, GeoJSON) was inaccessible through the available web retrieval path, so no planned building was accepted
